name: Division
overview: Scripture warns strongly against division, illustrating that a kingdom or house divided against itself cannot stand, highlighting the destructive nature of internal strife (Mark 3:24; Luke 11:17). Believers are exhorted to avoid those who cause divisions and offenses contrary to sound doctrine, emphasizing the importance of unity and peace within the body of Christ (Romans 16:17; Ephesians 4:3). Instead, Christians are called to embody humility, kindness, and longsuffering, fostering harmony as the elect of God (Colossians 3:12). Thus, division is portrayed as both a practical and spiritual threat that undermines God’s design for His people.
